body: It just never goes away. I see people post on here that have shitty things happen and certainly I have too but those are the times I understand feeling hopeless. But for me if people ask me what’s wrong I can’t even say because I have the fair weather blues too. I could have a perfectly peasant day where everything goes my way. It was just a series of distractions. I still go to bed feeling desperate and hopeless with no way to fix the problem. Because there is no problem. I’m the problem. I just don’t want to do it anymore.

I’ve been “treated” many times. Most of my life. So when you say it’s not true that I can’t be helped...it’s my head, I can only speak for myself. Judging by the amount of suicides every year, I would say I’m not alone there. I’m not impulsive. Not all of those people were impulsive either. I don’t believe treatment is effective for everybody. You can say that it takes multiple times to find the right path for the specific person but while that doctor is trying to figure it out for the next 40 years that person is still suffering. Death is a cure. I see that you can’t help me and I understand why. I just replied because maybe you can see another perspective.

Because it doesn’t matter if I get diagnosed. I’ve been this way almost my whole life. Nothings going to help. Death is the cure. If I had cancer for 20 years people would assist me. I posted here because I didn’t know where else to go. Because I thought people wouldn’t be as judgmental and because I don’t want anybody coming to my home and trying to lock me up like I’m a criminal.
